title: Resilience of parity
statement: Let $S$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinates, let $k$ be a natural number, and suppose $|S|=k+1$. The parity function on $S$ is resilient of order $k$: it is balanced, and every nonempty Fourier coefficient indexed by a set of at most $k$ coordinates is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite subset of the $n$ coordinates
